svg.title: Craterworks game icon
svg.desc: Original vector composition using editable paths and groups. No generated raster imagery or embedded bitmaps. Typography: Fredoka One, outlined for portable rendering.

g.title: Craterworks meteor and mining pickaxe
g.desc: An original vector illustration of a dark faceted meteor with connected amber fissures and a teal mining pickaxe. Every visible element is an editable vector shape.
